grain.description:
Used for usage summary based clustering

These fields are also required for profiling

numberOfClusters.description:
used for clustering and generation of cluster stats

used while generating cluster stats - (grain, usageSummaryType, clusterFieldName, clusterStatsType, timeRangeStart, timeRangeEnd

clusterFieldName.description: name of the field on the object which references the cluster it belongs to

isCustomClustering.description:
Used for custom clustering

set true if clustering is by type other than by usage summaries

isGeographicDistanceClustering.description:
Used for euclidean distance clustering
Use case is k-means clustering of buildingProfiles in res

set true if euclidean distance clustering desired

clusterCategories.description:
comma separated categories according to which we want to cluster
eg. 'usageData','buildingType,zipCode'

clusterByFieldPaths.description: comma separated path to category by which we want to cluster. (eg. servicePoint.bldgType, servicePoint.location.postalCode)

targetTypeRef.description:
These configurations are for target type for the map reduce job
target type on which map reduce code needs to start / startingType for clustering to start

targetDeviceIdPath.description: path to get the device (meter) id from target type

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings
